about_the_game:
A mysterious puzzle game that plays with your mind and pulls you into a deep time-travel adventure!

Something is wrong inside Hotel Luximinal. Rooms shift, objects change, the elevators test your patience and your sanity. You have been tasked with investigating what is happening in this hotel – and to document every anomaly you uncover. But the longer you remain within its walls and descend deeper into its spaces, the more you risk losing your mind. Now it is your time to solve the mystery.

7 Levels with Mysterious Charm

  • Golden Suites

  • Private Poolroom

  • Hotel Gallery

  • Waiting Area

  • Handsome Bar

  • Elegant Office

  • Shooting Suite

What to Expect:

Detective of Anomalies

It’s just you and your sharp eye: paintings that move, furniture that changes its place, clues that at first glance remain invisible. Every discovery brings you one step closer to the truth – and deeper into the hotel. Draw the right conclusions.

Sheer Madness

You think you understand it – but the hotel laughs at your certainty. It plays with your mind, tests your patience, and challenges your endurance. Can you face the trial without giving in, without cheating?

Challenge in Your Timeline

Elegant rooms filled with silence and trials – familiar, yet from other times. A hotel that behaves like a riddle itself. Every level, every image, almost every anomaly has something to tell you – if you are willing to look closely and connect the pieces.

Find all 210 Anomalies!

  • 30 anomalies in each of the 7 levels

  • Some are easy to spot

  • Others are trickier

  • Take your time to memorize everything

  • Levels get harder as you progress

  • Be careful, or you might get trapped forever!

Each correct choice brings you one floor higher. Get it right 7 times and return to the lobby.

The Rules Are Simple:

  • Start at floor 0

  • Upon entering: Study every detail in the room

  • Think there’s no anomaly? Enter the “other” elevator

  • Think there’s an anomaly? Return to the starting elevator

  • Correct guess: Go up one floor

  • Wrong guess: Return to floor 0

  • Guess correctly 8 times

  • Unlock the next level

  • Leave the hotel as a successful researcher for your company

Why Hotel Luximinal is unique

  • Detective work & anomaly hunting: The more anomalies you find, the more the puzzle comes together. Once you master all levels, you can finally solve the mystery of the hotel.

  • Replayable: After unlocking all levels, the anomalies reset and appear in new places. Test yourself again – can you still remember them all?

  • Time travel across three glamorous eras: 1925, 2025, and 2125 – from the golden Art Deco age to futuristic visions of Luximinal, androids, and time machines.

  • A challenge to your mind: For those who want more than a short anomaly hunt – a connected series of mysteries awaits. How quickly can you solve them all?

  • Seven levels, seven nights of madness: A week of eerie entertainment. Play one level each night – and recover, if you can. Soon you’ll know the hotel better than your own room.

  • Immersive Art Deco design: A surreal blend of elegance and unease, inspired by the glamour of the 1920s with a dreamlike twist.

  • Mysterious atmosphere: Dynamic soundscapes, unsettling visuals, and epic soundtracks – especially haunting in the hotel lobby.

Meet Payton

"I am Payton – concierge, security android, and loyal attendant of the Empire. I guide the guests through the hotel’s shimmering halls, help them uncover its secrets, and keep order in places where time itself seems broken.
Elegant in appearance, precise in duty, yet bound to the strange fate of the Luximinal, I watch over you as you wander. I am here to serve – but also to challenge."

Bonus: In the lobby, you will find a jukebox playing music. Enjoy the tunes, click through the tracks, and let the atmosphere sink in.

  • Jazz

  • Swing

  • Soft Background Music

This hotel is calling you – and it will test you. Will you uncover all the anomalies, or will they trap you inside the Hotel forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-2500K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 MB available space

short_description: Love spotting anomalies and exploring the glamorous Art Deco of 1925 New York? Dive into Hotel Luximinal – a captivating journey through surreal rooms where the ordinary turns extraordinary. Find hidden anomalies, uncover mysteries, and immerse yourself in a world of elegance and intrigue!
